## SyncFlow Strategic Briefing -> Gmail

Import this file, then do three things:
1. In **Verify the HMAC-SHA256 signature** replace PASTE_THE_SAME_SECRET_AS_CONTACT_WEBHOOK_SECRET with the value you set as CONTACT_WEBHOOK_SECRET on the site.
2. In **Send to Gmail** choose your Gmail OAuth2 credential (the sending account).
3. Activate the workflow and copy the **Production URL** of the Webhook into CONTACT_WEBHOOK_URL on the site.

A request with a wrong signature stops at **Signature is valid** and sends nothing. The same `id` sent twice becomes one e-mail (**Remove duplicates**).

Not tested against a live n8n by the author: the node versions below are the stable ones, but if n8n shows a parameter as missing after import, set it as docs/n8n-briefing.md describes. Test with: node scripts/n8n-test.mjs <production-url> <secret>
